appDescription: A parchment map of real places, footprints, and their stories.
chooseCountryBody: The country map loads after selection and starts at its own base scale.
countryUnavailable: This country map is temporarily unavailable
searchPlaceholder: City, street, or a specific place
searchHint: Press / or Ctrl K to search
loadError: The map could not be loaded
emptyMap: The map is waiting for its first pin.
confirmDeleteBody: It disappears from the public map immediately and remains recoverable for 30 days. Shared media will not be deleted.
discardBody: Changes from this editing session will be lost.
title: Title
placePlaceholder: Type 2+ characters and choose a place
placeRequired: Choose a confirmed place before saving
noMedia: Notes without media automatically use a sticky note.
loginBody: Use the site password to pin and arrange notes on desktop.
loginError: The password is incorrect or a session could not be created
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
mobileReadonly: Mobile remains read-only. Use a desktop to edit.
newPinHint: Right-click anywhere on the map to add a pin
dragPin: Drag the pin to fine-tune its position
unknownError: Something unexpected happened. Try again shortly.
notFoundTitle: This pin could not be found
notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or the address does not exist.
